about: Natalie S. Woodward is an attorney and partner at the Atlanta, Georgia, law firm of Warshauer Woodward Atkins. She offers tenacious legal representation to clients throughout the United States in personal injury and constitutional law matters. For two decades, she has handled a variety of legal matters such as:

Hailing from Powder Springs, Georgia, Ms. Woodward completed her Bachelor of Science in journalism and political science in 1999. She enrolled at the University of Georgia School of Law and earned her law degree in 2002. During her time there, she served as the president of her class and the chair of the Moot Court Board. She was also part of the university’s 2001 Champion Intrastate Moot Court Team.

A compassionate professional, Ms. Woodward is mindful of the emotional and psychological effects of a personal injury as well as its colossal impact on the life of a victim. With knowledge of how the responsible parties work in such situations, she fights for the rights of her clients at every step with integrity and fairness. She captured people's attention by obtaining a record-setting verdict of $1 million for a wrongfully arrested client in Georgia in her very first jury trial as a lead counsel.

Ms. Woodward appeared before the Georgia Court of Appeals, seeking increased protection for children exploited on social media. She was featured on national as well as international news channels for the spirit to safeguard the rights of children. Furthermore, she has fought for the rights of sexually abused children.
An active member of the State Bar of Georgia, Ms. Woodward currently sits on the board of its Statewide Judicial Evaluation Committee and the Senior Lawyers Committee.
